sample_unit: biopsy sites (52 patients with ulcerative colitis)
models_evaluated: AI-assisted ultra-magnifying colonoscopy system (EndoBRAIN-based contact microscopy AI)

links.outcome: AI vs endoscopist Mayo endoscopic score diagnostic performance for histological healing (Geboes score <3.1)
links.effect: MES0: sensitivity 79.2%, specificity 90.6%, PPV 97.7%, NPV 46.8%, accuracy 81.2%. AI: sensitivity 74.2%, specificity 93.8%, PPV 98.3%, NPV 42.3%, accuracy 77.5%; comparable overall.
links.quote: The AI system performed similarly to MES for the diagnosis of GS < 3.1: sensitivity, 74.2%; specificity: 93.8%; PPV: 98.3%; NPV: 42.3%; and accuracy: 77.5%.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a commercially available AI-assisted ultra-magnifying colonoscopy system comparing its diagnostic accuracy for histological healing against endoscopist scores and pathology.
